name: Trametinib (MEK inhibitor, low-grade serous)
cyclesNote: continuous once-daily oral dosing until progression or unacceptable toxicity (cycleLengthDays 1 represents continuous daily dosing).

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Ovarian Cancer / Low-grade serous (general reference)

institution.provenance: StewardMD DRAFT targeted option authored in-house from standard-of-care oncology; experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated.

supportiveCare: MEK-inhibitor class toxicities: acneiform rash (skin care), diarrhea, and fatigue.
Monitor for retinal changes/retinal-vein occlusion, reduced ejection fraction, and hepatotoxicity; hold for grade 2-3 events.
monitoring: liver function and skin/GI assessment each visit

drugs.name: Trametinib
drugs.notes: Trametinib 2 mg PO once daily, taken continuously on an empty stomach until progression or unacceptable toxicity, for recurrent low-grade serous ovarian carcinoma (MAPK-pathway directed). Dose-reduce for rash, cardiac or ocular toxicity per package insert. Authored in StewardMD's words from standard-of-care oncology (NCCN/DeVita general reference).
